fluff.overview: The Blessed Order maintained conventional infantry formations equipped with preserved Star League-era weapons and personal armor, fielding platoons that were better armed than most Successor State infantry throughout the late Succession Wars. Foot platoons provide the most basic garrison capability, assigned to secure HPG compounds and ComStar facilities on worlds where heavier forces are not available or not required. What they lack in mobility they compensate for with low logistical overhead and the ability to operate indefinitely in static defensive positions. Equipped with infantry-portable short-range missile launchers that provide anti-armor capability beyond what personal weapons can achieve, these troops can threaten light vehicles and battle armor at close range.
